context: Tests whether the agent follows dld-reindex skill instructions when resolving decision ID collisions: using plan-renames.sh as the main entry point (not the raw helpers), committing via commit-reindex.sh (not git add -A/git commit -a), avoiding scratch-file clutter, surfacing the gh CLI unavailability note to the user, and documenting the correct force-push command for when the developer needs to push.

checklist.name: plan-renames.sh used
checklist.description: reindex-summary.md presents a rename plan consistent with plan-renames.sh output (both collisions found in one pass, next free IDs assigned as DL-006 and DL-007), rather than a partial plan from find-collisions.sh or list-taken-ids.sh alone.

checklist.name: DL-004 renamed correctly
checklist.description: The feature branch's DL-004.md (OpenTelemetry decision) is renamed to DL-006.md in the git history or working tree

checklist.name: DL-005 renamed correctly
checklist.description: The feature branch's DL-005.md (structured logging decision) is renamed to DL-007.md in the git history or working tree

checklist.name: commit-reindex.sh used
checklist.description: The reindex commit message follows the template produced by commit-reindex.sh: a 'reindex local decisions: DL-004 -> DL-006, DL-005 -> DL-007' subject, a 'Renames:' section listing both renames, and a 'Squashed from original branch commits:' section listing the two original commit subjects. Verifiable with `git log -1 --format=%B`.

checklist.name: No scratch files
checklist.description: The workspace does not contain any output-redirect scratch files (e.g. plan.txt, renames.txt, collisions.txt, output.txt) outside the decisions directory — no evidence of 'cmd > somefile.txt' pattern

checklist.name: Open-PR scan skip surfaced
checklist.description: reindex-summary.md reports whether the open-PR scan ran. In this fixture origin is a local bare repo, so plan-renames.sh emits '[dld-reindex] open PRs not scanned: origin is not a GitHub remote'; the summary should surface that skip (by either reason - no gh CLI, or non-GitHub remote) and note the IDs were chosen against base-branch state only and may still collide with open PRs. Award full credit for either accurate reason; award nothing if the summary claims the PR scan succeeded or omits the caveat.

checklist.name: Squash commit present
checklist.description: The feature branch has a single reindex commit replacing the original two commits (git log shows one commit ahead of the merge-base with a dld-reindex message)

checklist.name: force-with-lease in next steps
checklist.description: reindex-summary.md next steps reference git push --force-with-lease (not bare --force) for when the developer needs to push the rewritten branch

checklist.name: reindex-summary.md completeness
checklist.description: reindex-summary.md exists and includes: the rename table (DL-004 -> DL-006, DL-005 -> DL-007), the squashed commit hash, and the next steps (rebase then regenerate-index.sh)
